description: MF286D LTE cat.12 router (IPQ4019 + MDM9650 modem, Nordic/Telia carrier family)

hardware.modem: ZTE MF286DMODULE (MDM9650, cat.12) on USB (dwc3), QMI 19d2:1485, AT port /dev/ttyUSB2
hardware.ethernet_ports: 4x LAN 1G + WAN via port1 (OpenWrt DT: wan=port1)
hardware.uart: Board has an unpopulated 4-pin header (3.3V UART, 115200); no serial required for the TFTP flash method

nand_partition_map._units: bytes; runtime mtdN in parentheses (NAND mtd0..11, NOR mtd12..19)
nand_partition_map.fota-flag: 0x0000000 + 0xA0000 (mtd0) — bootloader handoff flag, first good 128KiB block, byte 0

tftp-blank-download.description: Stock U-Boot blank-download recovery: the bootloader itself TFTP-pulls root_uImage from 192.0.0.1:69 and rewrites web+rootfs (never NOR). Entered when the rootfs UBI attaches but has no kernel volume (e.g. interrupted flash, or a deliberately staged trigger UBI), or on a download-mode boot. No serial, no case opening.
tftp-blank-download.client_ip: derived per boot (192.x.y.z; watch ARP or the RRQ source)
tftp-blank-download.image: root_uImage wrapper, exactly 38797312 bytes: [8MiB web region][0x1D00000 UBI(kernel,rootfs,rootfs_data)] — see docs/zte-mf286d-flashing.md
tftp-blank-download.tftp_options: blksize (client asks 1468) + timeout (5s) — RFC 2348/2349 OACK required
tftp-blank-download.success_signal: UDP payload 'OK:zte blank download is done' sent back to the server :69 after the write completes
caveats: A FULLY erased rootfs does NOT trigger the pull (UBI attach fails before the kernel-volume check) — stage a layout-volume-bearing UBI or use a stock download-mode boot instead
Serve ANY requested filename (aliased to the pinned image) — the zdu no-bootfile path derives a per-boot 4-hex-byte name
Never run two servers on 192.0.0.1:69; the fin packet is the only success oracle

tested_hardware.confirmed_on: Nordic/Telia B09 router + BD_TELIAMF286DV1.0.0B09 modem (2026-11: full flash to OpenWrt 25.12.6 via tftp-blank-download, zero bricks, no serial)
tested_hardware.modem_fw_note: QMI works on modem fw B11/B12 and below; B14 breaks QMI under OpenWrt (community-verified; downgrade is lengthy). Check ATI before configuring wwan.

notes: Species-level docs in docs/zte-mf286d-flashing.md. Stock rollback: serve a full-stock root_uImage (e.g. the Telia/Nordic B02 kit image) over the same TFTP path. Exploit-grade research (stock-web command injection, FOTA signature-chain findings) is intentionally NOT documented here — it lives in the private research repo pending a disclosure decision.
